build_wpo_policy: build a WPO actor core policy from networks and environment spec with optional observation stacking
build_wpo_actor: build a GenericActor with a variable client that pulls policy updates from the learner
build_wpo_learner: build a WPOLearner with AdamW optimizer, cosine LR decay, and multi-device SGD training
build_wpo_replay_tables: build Reverb replay tables with uniform sampling and FIFO queue for online experience
build_wpo_dataset_iterator: build a multi-device dataset iterator from Reverb with observation stacking and image augmentation
